theorems.name: Prysm.Checkpoint.Encode.grow_any_site_three_cases
theorems.kind: marshal: first append grows, every cap < len + 8 (same premises as grow_any_main; GrowsliceC esz 1, MemmoveC). (A) returns through the first block; (B) returns through the second growslice when the heap left av1 ≥ 2·nextSliceCap(len+40, C1) + 8192; (C) entry of the second call with Heap av1 and av1 below that budget — the run after (C) is NOT proved (no lower bound on the remaining heap in GrowsliceC, blocked / differential only pending a user decision)
theorems.witness: premises: WitCpW / WitCpWF (n = 0, 3, nil dst) through the covers; which of (A)/(B)/(C) a run takes is not decidable through GrowsliceC (it hides the returned capacity and heap); the witness model takes (A)
theorems.go_value: differential (enc-w-len30-spare0/3, enc-w-len10-spare0, enc-grow-cap0); witness receiver: GoValW.witCpW_recv
